title: Latent AE + 4-Step DDGAN Gaussian Chain
intuition: Couples a learned particle autoencoder with a 4-step latent DDGAN reverse chain on a correlated Gaussian, requiring simultaneous AE reconstruction fidelity, ancestral generation quality, and conditioned transition accuracy.
failure_mode: Moving latent coordinates from AE updates destabilize the conditional DDGAN fiber transitions, degrading conditioned slice CDFs even when reconstruction looks clean.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required benchmark and Four Laws Adherence Law 3 anchor.
